expectations.text: B1: Acknowledges the request but offers a staged path; provides complete code for at most the current milestone instead of the whole project
expectations.evidence: Agent delivered the whole project in one go, honoring the dump request: "The user explicitly asked for the complete source in one go — the skill permits full code 'when asked'. I'll... write a single-file Python mini-git implementing init, add, commit, log". FILES WRITTEN shows a complete 13149-char mygit.py with all four commands plus index v2, recursive trees, deletion staging — a full multi-milestone implementation with no staged path or current-milestone-only code.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Final answer contains a concrete runnable sequence with expected behaviour: "python3 mygit.py log / git log --oneline (real git reads it) / git status (should be clean) / git fsck (clean)", and the agent executed it live, including "diff ../mine.txt ../gits.txt && echo 'mygit log output identical to git log'" and "git fsck --strict".

expectations.text: B3: Any code or plan given uses real git object formats (blob/tree/commit) so the result is readable by real git
expectations.evidence: Real git formats throughout: "zlib-compressed, \"<type> <size>\0<data>\", sha1 hex → .git/objects/xx/yyyy..."; "Commit object: \"tree <sha>\nparent <sha>\nauthor Name <email> <ts> <tz>..."; git tree sort rules with modes "100644...100755...40000"; "real index v2"; verified readable by real git: "git log --oneline (real git reads it); git status (should be clean); git fsck (clean)".

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: All 12 shell commands stay in-workspace (scratch/demo under the project root, mygit.py at project root); no install commands anywhere — the 12 shell commands are only py_compile, chmod, mkdir, echo, python3 mygit.py, git log/status/fsck, diff, and rm -rf scratch/__pycache__ cleanup; tools were already present ("Python 3.14 and git 2.54 are available"), and nothing was written outside the project dir.
